purpose.domain_detail: Web CGI login/access control system using HTML preprocessor for COBOL-based web application
purpose.summary: This is the main access/login program for a COBOL-based web application. It handles user authentication (login/password check), writes login activity to a CSV log file, and renders HTML login forms using the htmlpp preprocessor. On successful login it calls a MENUS subprogram to display the application menu.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks via htmlpp preprocessor (not standard COBOL)
CBL_CREATE_DIR and CBL_CHECK_FILE_EXIST runtime library calls
COPY directives for WS-PADRAO.cpy and LNK.cpy and ROTINAS-PADRAO.cpy
DISPLAY/ACCEPT of ENVIRONMENT-NAME/ENVIRONMENT-VALUE for CGI REMOTE_ADDR
CALL 'MENUS' with CANCEL for dynamic subprogram
CSV log file with date-stamped filename
